intro.title: Performance & profiling
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Node.js application to measure and analyze the performance of a function. You will learn the core concept of profiling, which involves timing code execution to identify bottlenecks. The main technologies involved include Node.js's built-in `console.time` and `console.timeEnd` methods for basic performance measurement. This beginner-friendly project will help you understand how to make your code more efficient by tracking its speed.
intro.usecase: Performance profiling is essential for optimizing Node.js applications in production environments like e-commerce platforms, where slow API responses directly impact sales. Developers use profiling tools to identify bottlenecks in database queries, third-party API calls, or memory leaks in real-time dashboards that monitor user activity. For example, profiling helps optimize checkout flows by pinpointing slow payment gateway integrations or inefficient inventory lookup operations. This practice ensures applications remain responsive under heavy traffic, such as during flash sales or peak user sessions.
